reasoning_content: No mention of secrets in application.rb, and no credentials file either. So how does `Rails.application.secrets` get loaded from config/secrets.yml? In Rails 6.1, `Rails.application.secrets` uses credentials, and if credentials don't exist, an exception should be raised... except in cases where `secrets.yml` is being merged somewhere. Let me check for "secrets.yml" in config/boot.rb, the environment files, and the initializers.

action.command: cd /workspace && grep -rn "secrets.yml\|secrets\[" config/application.rb config/environment.rb config/boot.rb config/initializers/ | grep -v "\.git" | head -20

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && grep -rn \"secrets.yml\\|secrets\\[\" config/application.rb config/environment.rb config/boot.rb config/initializers/ | grep -v \"\\.git\" | head -20", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Find where secrets.yml is loaded"}
